title: My Help and My Deliverer

questions.question: I waited patiently for the Lord; he inclined to me and heard my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:1 (ESV): "I waited patiently for the Lord; he inclined to me and heard my cry."

questions.question: He drew me up from the pit of destruction, out of the miry what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:2 (ESV): "He drew me up from the pit of destruction, out of the miry bog,"

questions.question: He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:3 (ESV): "He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God."

questions.question: Blessed is the man who makes the Lord his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:4 (ESV): "Blessed is the man who makes the Lord his trust,"

questions.question: I delight to do your will, O my God; your law is within my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:8 (ESV): "I delight to do your will, O my God; your law is within my heart."

questions.question: You have multiplied, O Lord my God, your wondrous deeds and your thoughts toward whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:5 (ESV): "...your wondrous deeds and your thoughts toward us;"

questions.question: In sacrifice and offering you have not delighted, but you have given me an open what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:6 (ESV): "...but you have given me an open ear."

questions.question: I have told the glad news of deliverance in the great what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:9 (ESV): "I have told the glad news of deliverance in the great congregation;"

questions.question: Do not withhold your mercy from me, O Lord; let your steadfast love and your faithfulness ever do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:11 (ESV): "...let your steadfast love and your faithfulness ever preserve me!"

questions.question: For evils have encompassed me beyond number; my iniquities have overtaken me, and I cannot what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:12 (ESV): "...my iniquities have overtaken me, and I cannot see;"

questions.question: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me! O Lord, make haste to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:13 (ESV): "Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me! O Lord, make haste to help me!"

questions.question: Let those be put to shame and disappointed altogether who seek to snatch away my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:14 (ESV): "...who seek to snatch away my life;"

questions.question: May all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you! May those who love your salvation say continually, "Great is the what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:16 (ESV): "...May those who love your salvation say continually, 'Great is the Lord!'"

questions.question: As for me, I am poor and needy, but the Lord takes thought for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:17 (ESV): "As for me, I am poor and needy, but the Lord takes thought for me."

questions.question: Then I said, "Behold, I have come; in the scroll of the book it is written of whom?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 40:7 (ESV): "Then I said, 'Behold, I have come; in the scroll of the book it is written of me:'"

key_verse_text: I waited patiently for the Lord; he inclined to me and heard my cry.
